recognize_zh: 九宮格中的淋巴球為小至中型、核圓略有凹陷、染色質致密，細胞質淡藍且中等量，部分細胞一側有短絨毛狀突起（polar villi），但未見嗜天青顆粒，屬於邊緣區型淋巴球而非大顆粒淋巴球。
features: Small to medium lymphocytes with round to slightly indented or angulated nuclei and condensed chromatin
Moderate amounts of pale blue-grey cytoplasm, more abundant than in normal small lymphocytes
Several cells show short, often polar cytoplasmic projections (villous lymphocytes)
No visible azurophilic granules in the cytoplasm
Occasional nucleoli are not prominent; a normal segmented neutrophil is present for comparison
Normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase of small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round to slightly indented nuclei, condensed chromatin and moderate amounts of pale blue-grey cytoplasm. Several cells display short, predominantly polar cytoplasmic villous projections, and cytoplasmic azurophilic granules are not seen. Red cells are unremarkable. The findings represent a marginal zone-type lymphocytosis that can be mistaken for large granular lymphocytes at a glance; flow cytometry demonstrating a clonal B-cell population is required, and findings in the appropriate context are suggestive of circulating marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: LGLs have abundant clear cytoplasm with distinct azurophilic granules and a CD3+CD8+CD57+ phenotype, whereas these cells lack granules and are B cells.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine projections, oval to bean-shaped nuclei with looser chromatin, and are CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123 positive with BRAF V600E.
CLL cells have scant cytoplasm, clumped soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, with CD5+CD23+ phenotype.
MCL cells often have irregular nuclei without villi, are CD5 positive and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
